title: GUARD — was: a completer runs with `_comp_setup`'s IFS=$' \t\r\n\0' (zsh); zshrs's completers saw the caller's $' \t\n\0', because the `local IFS` shadow dropped the special's setfn

observed.detail: both shells show the message row ifs=$' \t\C-M\n\C-@'
observed.measured: 2026-10-30, target/debug/zshrs with the declare_locals PM_SPECIAL fix (zshrs 0.13.56) vs zsh 5.9.2 (/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh), scripts/compsys_regressions.py --only comp_setup_local_ifs_reaches_completers
observed.notes: compinit sh:183 (`_comp_setup`) is `local IFS=$' \t\r\n\0'`, eval'd by _main_complete sh:25 after its own sh:11 `local IFS=$' \t\n\0'`, so every completer sees the \r. The native _main_complete declares IFS through compsys::ported::shared::declare_locals and then writes it with setsparam; declare_locals created the shadow with createparam(name, PM_LOCAL) and stamped PM_SPECIAL afterwards, so createparam never carried the special's gsu over (params.rs createparam special-gsu arm skips a displaced shadow without PM_SPECIAL in the flags). Reads still went to ifsgetfn, writes never reached ifssetfn, and IFS stayed at the caller's value. Visible on the stock `typeset <TAB>` / `unset <TAB>` listing when any described value is printed with IFS: zsh prints `IFS -- \t\r` and the \r erases the row, zshrs did not.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: target/debug/zshrs built 2026-10-30 10:32 from HEAD 1c8da62e97 src/compsys/ported/shared.rs (before the fix), zshrs 0.13.56, vs zsh 5.9.2; scripts/compsys_regressions.py --only comp_setup_local_ifs_reaches_completers -> CONTROL-MOVED x3

why_this_fixture_exists: Found by round-3 lane-E comptab_parity sweep: `typeset `/`export `/`unset ` ctrl-d listings differed in their row and possibility counts; shrunk to the IFS row of a `_describe` listing of parameter values, then to the completer's own $IFS.

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

confirmed.note: CONTROL-HOLDS on the fixed binary; CONTROL-MOVED on the pre-fix binary
